name: musicbee-tagger-mcp
description: Investigate MusicBee metadata and stage verified tag proposals.
long_description: A local MCP server for reading audio metadata, researching MusicBrainz candidates, and staging metadata proposals for review. The MCP server never writes audio files and accepts only opaque tokens, not playlist or audio paths. A separate human-run CLI registers playlists and applies staged changes after confirmation.

tools.name: read_track_metadata
tools.description: Read embedded metadata for a registered track token.

tools.name: extract_filename_clues
tools.description: Extract unverified artist/title research clues from a registered filename. Candidates are ambiguous hypotheses, not authoritative tags.

tools.name: get_batch_brief
tools.description: Summarize metadata for a batch of registered track tokens.

tools.name: search_canonical_release
tools.description: Search MusicBrainz for candidate releases.

tools.name: verify_mbid
tools.description: Verify a MusicBrainz recording or release candidate.

tools.name: preview_tags
tools.description: Preview proposed metadata changes without writing audio.

tools.name: stage_tag_changes
tools.description: Stage metadata changes for human review. Filename-derived artist/title candidates are unverified clues and must be corroborated.

tools.name: list_staged_changes
tools.description: List pending metadata proposals without applying them.

tools.name: get_staged_change
tools.description: Read path-free stage notes, proposed values, current tags, diff, and revision.

tools.name: amend_staged_changes
tools.description: Revise a pending proposal with a reason and current revision; re-preview without writing audio. Use remove_fields to drop incorrect field proposals.

tools.name: withdraw_staged_change
tools.description: Soft-withdraw a pending proposal with a reason; withdrawn stages cannot be applied.

tools.name: next_batch
tools.description: Claim the next batch of work from a locally registered playlist job.

tools.name: complete_batch
tools.description: Record path-free results for a claimed playlist batch.

tools.name: release_batch
tools.description: Return selected in-progress tokens to pending after interrupted work.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Get aggregate progress for a playlist job.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List available playlist jobs with pending work using path-free summaries.

tools.name: enqueue_batch_operation
tools.description: Add a path-free operation to the persistent shared queue.

tools.name: list_batch_operations
tools.description: Query shared operations by status or batch.

tools.name: update_batch_operation
tools.description: Update a queued operation's status and progress details.

tools.name: repair_mojibake
tools.description: Suggest repairs for text corrupted by common encoding errors.

tools.name: identify_acrcloud
tools.description: Identify a registered track using ACRCloud (opt-in fallback).

data_directory.title: MusicBee Tagger data directory
data_directory.description: Use the same directory as the playlist registration and apply CLI. The default matches this project's Windows release installer.
